source_replacements.old:
$listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $Port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    Assert-That ($listeners.Count -gt 0 -and @($listeners|Where-Object{$_.OwningProcess -ne $server.process.Id}).Count -eq 0) 'The listening port is not owned by the recorded server.'
source_replacements.new:
$listeners=@([Scotty20261125TrayJobInspector]::ListenerOwners($Port))
    Assert-That ($listeners.Count -gt 0 -and @($listeners|Where-Object{$_ -ne $server.process.Id}).Count -eq 0) 'The listening port is not owned by the recorded server.'

Preserve both failed predecessor tasks, receipts, results and logs.
